metadata.title: चलिए, चलें छत्तीसगढ़ के आदिवासियों से मिलने | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Our team left National Tribal  Dance Festival, and has now reached Dhamtari. On this tour, we will be meeting the Tribal groups of Chhattisgarh. We plan to bring lots of ground reports and episodes of The Tribal Kitchen for you from there. So stay tuned, and thank you for your support.

#mainbhibharat #chhattisgarh #tribal_india
